entry.content:
After 12 months of development.. the Proxmark 3 RDV4 goes totally standalone.

Exceptional Bluetooth performance coupled with a high-capacity rechargeable battery. High quality machined aluminium and glass finish, compact and discrete.

Totally integrated into the official Proxmark 3 codebase - the standalone kit is tested and ready to use out of the box.

During pre-order, Lab401.com is providing an immediate 10% discount, before the official release of June 1.
